name: Rolling Comparison Window
description: Maintains a fixed-size deque of ComparisonPair samples per task type. Each pair includes: timestamp, input, local response, remote response, evaluation score. Supports: adding new pairs, computing aggregate correlation (mean of evaluation scores), computing trend (slope of scores over recent N pairs), checking staleness (is oldest pair older than max_window_age). Persists to disk (JSON) for survival across restarts. Thread-safe via threading.Lock. One instance per task type; parent component manages the task_type-to-window mapping.

types.name: ComparisonPair

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 formatted UTC-aware datetime of when the comparison was captured. Must include timezone info (UTC). Represented as str for serialization; parsed/validated as UTC-aware datetime internally.

validators.error_message: timestamp must be an ISO-8601 UTC-aware datetime string

fields.name: input_data
fields.description: The input (prompt/query) that was sent to both local and remote models.

validators.error_message: input_data must be a non-empty string

fields.name: local_response
fields.description: The response produced by the local model for the given input.

fields.name: remote_response
fields.description: The response produced by the remote model for the given input.

fields.name: evaluation_score
fields.description: Evaluation score comparing local vs remote response quality. 0.0 = no match/correlation, 1.0 = perfect match/correlation.

validators.error_message: evaluation_score must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

types.description: Immutable (frozen) Pydantic v2 value object representing a single comparison sample between local and remote model responses, with an evaluation score. All datetimes must be UTC-aware.

types.name: TrendDirection
types.description: Direction of the evaluation score trend over recent comparison pairs.

types.name: TrendResult

fields.name: slope
fields.description: Slope of linear regression over evaluation_scores ordered by time. Positive = improving, negative = degrading. Units: score change per sample index.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Categorized trend direction derived from slope magnitude and sign.

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Number of comparison pairs used in the trend computation.

validators.error_message: sample_count must be at least 2 for trend computation

types.description: Result of trend computation over recent comparison pairs. Contains the linear regression slope, a categorized direction, and the number of samples used in the computation.

types.name: WindowSnapshot

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version for forward-compatible migration. Current version is 1.

validators.error_message: schema_version must be a positive integer

fields.name: task_type
fields.description: The task type identifier this window tracks.

validators.error_message: task_type must be a non-empty string

fields.name: pairs
fields.description: Ordered list of ComparisonPair objects in the window, oldest first.

fields.name: window_size
fields.description: The configured maximum window size (deque maxlen) so it can be restored.

validators.error_message: window_size must be a positive integer

fields.name: max_window_age_seconds
fields.description: The configured max_window_age as total seconds, for serialization of timedelta.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 formatted UTC-aware datetime of when this snapshot was created.

validators.error_message: created_at must be an ISO-8601 UTC-aware datetime string

types.description: Serialization envelope for persisting a RollingComparisonWindow to disk as JSON. Contains a schema_version for forward-compatible migration, the task type identifier, all current pairs, and a creation timestamp.

types.name: OptionalFloat
types.description: Optional float — None indicates no data available (empty window).

types.name: OptionalTrendResult
types.description: Optional TrendResult — None indicates insufficient data for trend computation (fewer than 2 pairs).

types.name: OptionalBool
types.description: Optional bool — None indicates no data available to determine staleness (empty window).

types.name: OptionalInt
types.description: Optional int for the recent_n parameter in get_trend.

types.name: OptionalStr
types.description: Optional string for the as_of datetime parameter (ISO-8601 UTC).

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Constructs a new RollingComparisonWindow for a given task type. Initializes an empty collections.deque with maxlen=window_size and a threading.Lock. Performs NO file I/O. The window starts empty and must be populated via add_pair() or from_snapshot()/load().

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Identifier for the task type this window tracks. Must be non-empty.

validators.error_message: task_type must be a non-empty string

inputs.name: window_size
inputs.description: Maximum number of ComparisonPair entries to retain. When full, oldest pair is evicted on add.

inputs.name: max_window_age_seconds
inputs.description: Maximum age in seconds for the oldest pair before the window is considered stale. Default is 72 hours (259200 seconds). Internally stored as timedelta.

error_cases.name: empty_task_type
error_cases.condition: task_type is an empty string

error_data.message: task_type must be a non-empty string

error_cases.name: invalid_window_size
error_cases.condition: window_size < 1 or window_size > 10000

error_data.message: window_size must be between 1 and 10000

error_cases.name: invalid_max_window_age
error_cases.condition: max_window_age_seconds <= 0

error_data.message: max_window_age_seconds must be positive

preconditions: window_size is a positive integer between 1 and 10000
postconditions: Window is initialized with zero pairs
Internal deque has maxlen set to window_size
Threading lock is initialized
No file I/O has been performed

structured_side_effects.description: Pure initialization, no I/O or external effects

functions.name: add_pair
functions.description: Appends a ComparisonPair to the rolling window. If the deque is at capacity (window_size), the oldest pair is automatically evicted. Thread-safe: acquires the internal lock for the duration of the mutation.

inputs.name: pair
inputs.description: The comparison pair to add. Must be a valid ComparisonPair with UTC-aware timestamp.

error_cases.name: invalid_pair_type
error_cases.condition: pair is not a valid ComparisonPair instance

error_data.message: pair must be a ComparisonPair instance

error_cases.name: naive_timestamp
error_cases.condition: pair.timestamp is a naive datetime (no timezone info)

error_data.message: pair.timestamp must be UTC-aware

preconditions: pair is a valid ComparisonPair instance
postconditions: Window contains the new pair as the most recent entry
len(window) <= window_size
If window was at capacity before add, the oldest pair has been evicted
If window was not at capacity, len(window) has increased by 1

structured_side_effects.description: Appends pair to deque; may evict oldest if at capacity

functions.name: get_aggregate_score
functions.description: Computes and returns the arithmetic mean of evaluation_scores across all pairs currently in the window. Returns None if the window is empty, to distinguish 'no data' from 'score is 0.0'. Thread-safe: acquires the internal lock for the duration of the read.
postconditions: If window is empty, returns None
If window is non-empty, returns mean of all evaluation_scores
Return value, when not None, is in range [0.0, 1.0]

structured_side_effects.description: Pure read operation, no state mutation

functions.name: get_trend
functions.description: Computes the linear regression slope of evaluation_scores over the most recent N pairs (ordered by insertion time). Uses statistics.linear_regression from the Python 3.12+ stdlib. Returns a TrendResult with slope, categorized direction, and sample count. Returns None if fewer than 2 pairs are available for computation. Thread-safe: acquires the internal lock for the duration of the read. Direction categorization: slope > 0.001 => 'improving', slope < -0.001 => 'degrading', otherwise 'stable'.

inputs.name: recent_n
inputs.description: Number of most-recent pairs to use for trend computation. If None, uses all pairs in the window. If provided, must be >= 2. Clamped to window length if larger than current window size.

validators.error_message: recent_n must be None or at least 2

error_cases.name: invalid_recent_n
error_cases.condition: recent_n is not None and recent_n < 2

error_data.message: recent_n must be at least 2 if provided

postconditions: If window has fewer than 2 pairs (or recent_n results in fewer than 2), returns None
If result is not None, result.sample_count >= 2
If result is not None, result.direction is one of 'improving', 'stable', 'degrading'
If result is not None, result.slope reflects the linear regression slope of scores vs sample index

functions.name: is_stale
functions.description: Checks whether the oldest pair in the window is older than max_window_age. Returns True if stale (oldest pair timestamp + max_window_age < as_of), False if not stale, None if the window is empty. Thread-safe. The as_of parameter defaults to datetime.now(timezone.utc) but is injectable for deterministic testing.

inputs.name: as_of
inputs.description: ISO-8601 UTC-aware datetime to use as 'now' for the staleness check. If None, uses datetime.now(timezone.utc). Must be UTC-aware if provided.

error_cases.name: naive_as_of
error_cases.condition: as_of is provided but is not UTC-aware

error_data.message: as_of must be a UTC-aware datetime string

error_cases.name: invalid_as_of_format
error_cases.condition: as_of is provided but cannot be parsed as ISO-8601

error_data.message: as_of must be a valid ISO-8601 datetime string

preconditions: as_of is None or is a valid ISO-8601 UTC-aware datetime string
postconditions: If window is empty, returns None
If window is non-empty and oldest pair is older than max_window_age relative to as_of, returns True
If window is non-empty and oldest pair is within max_window_age relative to as_of, returns False

functions.name: __len__
functions.description: Returns the number of ComparisonPair entries currently in the window. Thread-safe.
postconditions: Return value >= 0
Return value <= window_size

functions.name: to_snapshot
functions.description: Serializes the current window state into a WindowSnapshot for persistence or transfer. No I/O is performed; the caller is responsible for writing the snapshot to disk via persist(). Thread-safe: acquires the internal lock for the duration of the read. The created_at field is set to datetime.now(timezone.utc).
postconditions: Returned snapshot.schema_version == 1
Returned snapshot.task_type == self.task_type
Returned snapshot.pairs contains all current pairs in insertion order
len(snapshot.pairs) == len(self)
Returned snapshot.window_size == self.window_size
Returned snapshot.max_window_age_seconds == self.max_window_age as total seconds
Returned snapshot.created_at is a UTC-aware ISO-8601 datetime string

functions.name: from_snapshot
functions.description: Class method. Deserializes a WindowSnapshot into a new RollingComparisonWindow instance. Validates all data in the snapshot (pair scores, timestamps, schema version). This is the inverse of to_snapshot(). No I/O is performed.

inputs.name: snapshot
inputs.description: The WindowSnapshot to deserialize into a RollingComparisonWindow.

error_cases.name: unsupported_schema_version
error_cases.condition: snapshot.schema_version is not a recognized version (currently only 1)

error_data.message: Unsupported schema version: {version}. Only version 1 is supported.

error_cases.name: invalid_snapshot_data
error_cases.condition: snapshot contains invalid pair data that fails Pydantic validation

error_data.message: Snapshot contains invalid ComparisonPair data

error_cases.name: invalid_snapshot_type
error_cases.condition: snapshot is not a valid WindowSnapshot instance

error_data.message: snapshot must be a WindowSnapshot instance

preconditions: snapshot is a valid WindowSnapshot instance
All pairs in snapshot.pairs are valid ComparisonPair instances
postconditions: Returned window has task_type == snapshot.task_type
Returned window has window_size == snapshot.window_size
Returned window has max_window_age == timedelta(seconds=snapshot.max_window_age_seconds)
len(returned_window) == len(snapshot.pairs), clamped to window_size
Pairs are in the same order as snapshot.pairs (if len(pairs) <= window_size, the most recent window_size pairs are retained)

functions.name: persist
functions.description: Atomically writes the current window state to disk as JSON. Uses to_snapshot() internally, then writes to a temporary file and performs os.replace() for atomic swap. This ensures no partial writes on crash. Thread-safe: acquires the internal lock for the snapshot read, then releases before I/O (I/O is on the immutable snapshot). Creates parent directories if they do not exist.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File system path (as string) where the JSON snapshot will be written. Parent directories are created if needed.

validators.error_message: path must be a non-empty string

error_cases.name: permission_denied
error_cases.condition: Process lacks write permissions to path or its parent directory

error_data.message: Cannot write to path: permission denied

error_cases.name: disk_full
error_cases.condition: Insufficient disk space to write the snapshot

error_data.message: Failed to write snapshot: disk full or I/O error

error_cases.name: invalid_path
error_cases.condition: path is not a valid filesystem path

error_data.message: Invalid file path provided

preconditions: path is a non-empty string representing a valid file system path
Parent directory of path is writable (or can be created)
postconditions: File at path contains valid JSON representing a WindowSnapshot
File write was atomic (via temp file + os.replace)
No temporary files remain on success
Parent directories exist

structured_side_effects.description: Atomic write of window state as JSON via temp file + os.replace

functions.name: load
functions.description: Class method. Loads a RollingComparisonWindow from a JSON file previously written by persist(). Reads the file, parses as WindowSnapshot, validates all data, and constructs a new window via from_snapshot(). Thread-safe (constructs a new instance).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File system path (as string) of the JSON snapshot file to load.

validators.error_message: path must be a non-empty string

error_cases.condition: No file exists at the specified path

error_data.message: Snapshot file not found at path

error_cases.name: permission_denied

error_data.message: Cannot read snapshot file: permission denied

error_cases.condition: File contents are not valid JSON

error_data.message: Snapshot file contains invalid JSON

error_cases.name: invalid_snapshot_schema

error_data.message: Snapshot file does not conform to WindowSnapshot schema

error_cases.name: unsupported_schema_version

error_data.message: Unsupported schema version in snapshot file

error_data.message: Snapshot contains corrupted or invalid comparison pair data

preconditions: File at path exists and is readable
File contains valid JSON conforming to WindowSnapshot schema
postconditions: Returned window is a fully valid RollingComparisonWindow
Returned window state matches the persisted snapshot
Returned window.task_type matches the task_type in the file
Returned window.window_size matches the window_size in the file

structured_side_effects.description: Reads and parses JSON snapshot file from disk

invariants: All pairs in the window have evaluation_score in [0.0, 1.0]
All pairs in the window have UTC-aware timestamps
Pairs are stored in insertion order (oldest at index 0, newest at end)
The internal deque maxlen equals window_size and never changes after construction
One RollingComparisonWindow instance corresponds to exactly one task_type
All public method calls are thread-safe via internal threading.Lock
Empty window methods return None (not 0.0 or False) to distinguish no-data from bad-data
Persistence is explicit and caller-controlled; no automatic writes on add_pair
Persisted JSON always includes schema_version for forward-compatible migration
Atomic file writes ensure no partial/corrupt state on disk
No global state; all state is instance-scoped and injected via constructor parameters
